## Education

|---|---|
| 11/2018 – 2026 | **PhD student**, International Max Planck Research School for Neural Circuits, Frankfurt. Thesis *Emergence of reliable sensory representations in cortical development*, submitted 01/2026. Supervisor: Matthias Kaschube |
| 06/2020 – 11/2024 | Member, **Center for Multiscale Modelling**, Frankfurt |
| 10/2016 – 10/2018 | **MSc Biophysics**, Goethe University Frankfurt. Thesis: *The role of network interactions in refining neural response properties in visual cortex*. Supervisor: Matthias Kaschube. Final grade 1.0 |
| 10/2013 – 11/2016 | **BSc Biophysics**, Goethe University Frankfurt. Thesis: *Development of coding properties in mammalian visual cortex*. Supervisor: Matthias Kaschube. Final grade 1.3 |
| 2009 – 2013 | **Landesschule Pforta**, Department of Natural Science. Abitur, final grade 1.0 |
